title: Wanderlust
description: A full-stack accommodation booking platform inspired by Airbnb, designed to provide a seamless experience for discovering and managing property listings. The project focuses on building a complete web application with dynamic content, user authentication, property management, database integration, and responsive UI, while following a structured MERN-based development approach.

title: Zerodha Clone
description: A full-stack stock trading platform inspired by Zerodha, built to recreate the core experience of a modern investment dashboard. The project includes an interactive interface for viewing market-related data, managing holdings and positions, and working with order-related functionality. It focuses on responsive frontend development, backend API integration, data management, and building a clean dashboard-oriented user experience.

title: Smartcart Clustering System
description: A machine learning-based customer segmentation system designed to identify meaningful groups of customers based on their purchasing behavior and related attributes. The project applies data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, feature selection, and clustering techniques to discover patterns within customer data, helping demonstrate how unsupervised learning can be used to derive actionable insights from real-world datasets.

title: Creditwise Loan Approval System
description: A machine learning-based loan eligibility prediction system designed to evaluate applicant information and predict potential loan approval outcomes. The project involves preprocessing financial and demographic data, handling relevant features, training and evaluating classification models, and comparing model performance to build a reliable prediction pipeline for a practical financial decision-making problem.
